title: The Cobra Effect: When Chasing Metrics Ruins Your Life
alt_title_1: Goodhart's Law: The Trap Behind Vanity Metrics
alt_title_2: How Colonial Delhi Accidentally Multiplied Its Cobras
description_hook: When colonial officials paid a cash bounty for dead cobras in Delhi, locals started farming venomous snakes for profit. Here is how Charles Goodhart's Law explains why chasing vanity metrics ruins modern careers and wealth.

scenes.headline: How a Snake Bounty Multiplied Snakes
scenes.stat_label: MORE WILD COBRAS AFTER DELHI'S BOUNTY BACKFIRED
bullets: Officials paid cash for every dead cobra skin delivered
Incentives quietly rewired human behavior overnight
scenes.narration: When colonial officials in Delhi offered cash bounties for every dead cobra, the city somehow ended up with even more venomous snakes.

scenes.headline: From Backyard Snake Farms to Goodhart's Law
bullets: Enterprising locals bred cobras indoors for steady payouts
Canceled bounty -> worthless snakes released into Delhi
scenes.narration: Locals started breeding cobras in backyard sheds just to collect the payout. When officials discovered the scheme and canceled the bounty, breeders released the worthless snakes into the streets.

scenes.headline: When Measures Become Targets, They Break
scenes.left_body: Fake desk hours, app streaks, viral vanity views
scenes.right_body: Rare skills, finished products, net cashflow margin
scenes.narration: In 1975, British economist Charles Goodhart turned this failure into Goodhart's Law: the moment a measure becomes a target, it ceases to be a good measure.

scenes.headline: Audit Your Personal Vanity Metrics
scenes.stat_subtext: Track metrics lightly • Optimize for real-world capability
scenes.narration: You fall into the exact same trap whenever you chase hours logged at a desk, app streaks, or vanity views instead of real skills and cashflow margin.

scenes.headline: Use Numbers as a Compass, Never an Idol
scenes.stat_label: SEPARATE THE PROXY FROM THE PRIZE
bullets: Ask: could I hit this number while getting worse?
Reward durable output over cosmetic dashboards
scenes.narration: Use numbers as a quiet compass, never as your identity, because the second you worship the scoreboard you start gaming yourself - just like...
